description.content: White Point Surveying & Mapping is hiring an Entry CAD Technician to help turn field measurements and project information into clear land surveying drawings. This is an entry-level office role for someone who is careful with details and ready to learn survey drafting from experienced staff.

You will prepare and revise survey drawings, organize field data and supporting records, follow redlines, and check your work for accuracy. You will work with field crews and senior staff on boundary, topographic, and construction surveying projects. Final survey decisions and approvals remain with the supervising surveyor.
The pay range is $15-$18 per hour, based on skills and experience. We do not currently offer a standard benefits package, but we are open to discussing an arrangement with the right candidate.

requirements: Basic familiarity with CAD drafting or technical drawing; coursework or personal projects are welcome
Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn land surveying standards and workflows
Ability to follow instructions, ask questions, and communicate clearly with the team
No prior land surveying employment required
